verdicts.reason: Both resizes are almost the same and broken in the same ways. The search-bar motif is split apart: an empty white pill floats on its own, the black search button has grown into a heavy blob at the top, and the headline sits outside the bar. The laptop and desk imagery is gone, leaving only cropped glasses and loose black arcs. The 'ОНЛАЙН-КУРС' subline is almost as large as the headline, so the two compete. The two differ only by a few pixels of vertical shift (B sits slightly higher, with marginally more room above the CTA), which isn't enough to separate them.
